structuralUnitGate.meaning: Behavioral tests exercise real modules on controlled synthetic data. They establish their stated identities, geometry, collision ordering, timing, resource ownership and failure invariants; they do not prove complete real-city gameplay or device FPS.
limits: The original external ../tools legacy regression scripts are absent from the hosted repository; their historical suite is not claimed as passed.
The coordinator owns the authoritative final complete-suite/build output; do not infer it merely from these source paths.
The synthetic replay covers actual Player physics on a flat fixture at 30/60/90/120 presentation schedules, not deterministic whole Game, network, traffic, route and delivery execution.

highStaticPixelMatch.result: High day and night 1280x592 fixed-camera RGB images match exactly: MAE 0, maximum channel difference 0, 100% equal pixels, matching PNG SHA256 within each mood.
highStaticPixelMatch.limits: Day residency matched at seven active tiles; night baseline had eight versus candidate seven. Visible equality does not establish identical full-city residency, all sign readability, moving LOD transitions, all landmark silhouettes or live-game FPS.

androidSoftwareCompatibility.environment: Android15 API35 Chrome124 on agent-created AVD using SwiftShader on the Mac; Pixel7a screen/RAM profile is not a Pixel7a processor or GPU emulation.
androidSoftwareCompatibility.limits: Host-GPU AVD purple-world failures reproduced on the untouched baseline. Visible 3D software-rendered follow-up is valid compatibility evidence, not Samsung hardware rendering, phone GPU speed, heat, battery life or 90/120Hz certification.

controlledCpuMeasurements.calibration: Chrome DevTools published calibration algorithm via CDP fitted 4.04x mid-tier and 16.05x low-tier CPU slowdown; not a phone GPU or thermal simulation.
controlledCpuMeasurements.boundedResult: locked-sustained-mid recorded a 30s warmup and 125.1808s measurement window, 7431 frames, histogram upper p50/p95/p99 17/19/25ms. The controller includes stationary idle time after completing its route, so this is not 125s of continuous moving dense-city stress.
limits: A candidate sample meeting the 60Hz interval thresholds is not a complete scenario/whole-game pass and is not a percentage gain versus baseline.
No complete paired seeded/clocked/network-residency-controlled whole-Game A/B harness or three comparable route pairs exists. No whole-game percentage FPS gain is established.
90/120 options and synthetic timing invariance are tested; actual sustained 90/120Hz output on compatible hardware is unverified.

observedLimits: Atomic graph/sign/metadata publication retains synchronous work; measured installation/activation overruns exist. The 1.5ms foreground allowance is a scheduling target, not a universal bound proven by these runs.

Android final startup recorded maximum install 405.3ms on BJIR, and 532.6ms install / 57.3ms activation on mkht0607, while the loader was covering preparation. These host-emulator startup measurements must not be hidden or presented as phone foreground frame times.

The earlier 24 clean settled endpoint samples cover eight loops, fewer than the ten post-warmup loops required by the plan. Tile counts and owned active-byte estimates repeat exactly, but renderer textures still warm upward and a full retained GPU-resource plateau is not established.
JS heap sawtooth without equal-state post-GC measurements is not a leak proof. Earlier cycle snapshots omit pending reservations. Byte estimates are not total GPU/browser memory.
